requested_impactor.description: 20 g solid steel sphere; diameter inferred from assumed steel density after user correction.

recommended_impactor.description: Solid steel sphere modeled as rigid, with consistent mass and geometry.

strain_control.definition: Principal engineering strains from stretch eigenvalues: epsilon_i=lambda_i-1.
strain_control.enforcement: Monitor integration-point stretches; stop or reduce load before exceeding the range. Never clip material strain or artificially harden to enforce a cap.
strain_control.note: The tensile upper cap is a conservative user-requested 40% deformation limit, not the tensile test range. Central deflection divided by film thickness is not material compression strain for a suspended film.

recommended_first_pilot.selection: Only retain stages passing local strain and quasi-static checks; extend only if appropriate.
recommended_first_pilot.loading: Smooth imposed displacement with velocity and acceleration starting at zero; gravity drop is not combined with this loading.
recommended_first_pilot.note: This is a controlled indentation comparison, not a 20cm drop-impact simulation; striker mass does not determine the quasi-static stress state.

dynamic_followup.instruction: Sequential pilot ladder only: stop increasing speed when local strains or stability fail. No prediction that any listed speed is safe.
dynamic_followup.start: Small gap above film with downward initial velocity; v=0 at contact without another load does not represent a 20cm drop.

mesh_proposal.convergence: Refine contact zone and thickness; compare stress fields and reaction force.

compress.operation: Subtract first recorded strain and stress; first point treated as unloaded reference per user instruction.
compress.negative_stress_handling: Preserved as measurement noise, not silently clipped.
compress.remaining_processing: Monotone smoothing and a common near-origin tangent must be checked before material-card use; post-peak tension is not a hardening input.

strain.operation: Subtract first recorded strain and stress; first point treated as unloaded reference per user instruction.
strain.negative_stress_handling: Preserved as measurement noise, not silently clipped.
strain.remaining_processing: Monotone smoothing and a common near-origin tangent must be checked before material-card use; post-peak tension is not a hardening input.
